column9: the non-gas captive fleet stays NE in the reference; the rows below are the register-sized screening and its named exclusions

bought coal no held control covers; priced at the bracket TOP, the conservative-top convention. capacity factor 0.2-0.7 and heat rate 9-12 MJ/kWh are DECLARED JUDGEMENTS - no Pakistani captive-utilization statistic is published; NEPRA's captive licensing returns (annual generation) would collapse the bracket

non-bagasse biomass: biogenic CO2 is outside every total by construction, so the countable gases are CH4+N2O - bounded small, the bagasse pattern. capacity factor 0.2-0.7 and heat rate 9-12 MJ/kWh are DECLARED JUDGEMENTS - no Pakistani captive-utilization statistic is published; NEPRA's captive licensing returns (annual generation) would collapse the bracket

captive FO/diesel buy from the same market the OCAC Total Industry rows already book into the estimated industrial-liquids category; whether a given engine's fuel is inside that control is the per-class split only the HDIP commercial energy balance resolves, so pricing it here would risk a double-count - possibly included elsewhere, not unexamined
the bagasse all-cane CEILING configuration already burns the entire crop's bagasse; captive bagasse power is a sub-claimant of that ceiling and adding it here would double-claim the same stalks

one steel works' blast-furnace/coke-oven gas train: its carbon is the works' own coal and coke inputs, and pricing it needs the works' gas balance, not a capacity guess - a capacity bracket would claim precision the fuel chemistry does not support
solar, hydel, wind, biogas and waste-heat capacity: excluded arithmetically, not silently
the gas-primary fleet with labelled capacity, for scale; the metered gas control (power module, 5.55 Mt) covers captive gas regardless of the capacity label, which most gas plants lack
